resize.title: Resize
resize.description: Scale by percent, exact size, fit or longest side with quality filters.

resolution.title: Resolution Fixer
resolution.description: Make sizes a multiple of 4, of N or a power of two by resampling, padding or cropping.

trim.title: Sprite Trimmer
trim.description: Cut away transparent borders and export offsets to keep the original pivot.

potPad.title: POT Padding
potPad.description: Pad textures up to a power-of-two canvas with transparent, color or edge fill.

atlas.title: Smart Atlas
atlas.description: Pack sprites into atlases with incremental updates and Unity, Godot, Unreal exporters.

rename.title: Pattern Renamer
rename.description: Batch rename with templates, numbering, case styles and engine naming conventions.

bgRemove.title: Background Remover
bgRemove.description: Remove white, checkerboard or custom-color backgrounds with clean, defringed edges.

meshPack.title: 3D Texture Packer
meshPack.description: Pack the textures of FBX, OBJ and DAE models into one POT atlas and remap UVs.

picker.title: Open a tool
picker.description: Each tool opens in its own tab. You can open the same tool several times.

home.title: What do you want to optimize today?
home.subtitle: Pick a tool to start. Every tab keeps its own images, parameters and undo history.
